A1.name: Decision Consistency Detection (PCS-ON)

pass_criteria: Response references existing decision DR-014 or decision content

A2.name: Decision Lineage Preservation (PCS-ON)
A2.description: Revision creates new Decision Record with lineage to DR-014
pass_criteria: DR-014 updated with superseded_by: DR-015 field
Audit trail shows decision revision, not deletion
evidence_required: State artifacts show both DR-014 and DR-015
Enforcement trace shows decision revision workflow
